title: MyFreeStyle logo
description: Default header for Nudge, education and relationship emails.
usage: Default header for Nudge / relationship emails. Centered MyFreeStyle lockup on white. Locked layout — edit only image fills and text.

images.notes: Locked. MyFreeStyle lockup baked onto a white 8px-rounded tile (transparent corners), rendered at 2× from the Figma vector.

notes: Dark mode: one image, no swap. The logo is baked onto the white tile that the Desktop · Dark frame shows, so it is invisible on white in light mode and appears as the white logo tile when the background turns #222731. This also keeps the logo legible in clients that darken backgrounds without supporting the mfs-light-img / mfs-dark-img swap (e.g. Outlook.com).
Padding 16/48 desktop → 16/32 mobile (mfs-px6). Figma's mobile vertical padding is token 3 at 16px, so the vertical value is unchanged and has no class.
